image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a black audio cassette tape. The image shows the top half of the cassette body, including two white spools with cross-shaped hubs, a central rectangular window revealing dark magnetic tape, and molded plastic details on the casing surface. Faint, illegible text is visible on the upper label area.

artifact_observations.location: Upper label area of the cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is nonsensical, blurred, and lacks character structure. It appears as smudged patterns rather than legible letters, a common AI artifact when rendering text.
The plastic texture is overly uniform and slightly soft, lacking the fine scratches, dust, or sharp specular highlights expected on real aged plastic. It has a slight 'waxy' appearance.

The cross-shaped indentations on the spool hubs are slightly irregular and asymmetrical between the left and right spools. The geometry is plausible but not perfectly manufactured, suggesting minor generative inconsistency.
